card.product_version_note: Launched September 15, 2020 as a World Elite Mastercard (Chase newsroom release, media.chase.com/news/chase-freedom-flex-launch); the current product page does not name the network, and no 2026 source read today reports a network change. Refreshed in 2026: cell phone protection ended September 20, 2026 (eligible losses through September 19, 2026 still covered), the 3% foreign transaction fee was removed effective September 20 or 21, 2026 (secondary sources say Sep 20; Chase press release dated Sep 21 says 'starting today'), Points Boost hotel offers and a next-quarter category preview were added, new card art issued, and a limited-time $250 welcome offer replaced $200. Older Chase Freedom (Visa) cards, closed to new applicants, share the same 5% rotating calendar. The product page shows two 5% calendars that disagree on Q1-Q2 2026 contents; the 'Maximize your spend' calendar is treated as authoritative here because it matches the Sep 15 and Sep 21, 2026 Chase press releases.

benefits.name: 5% quarterly bonus category activation
benefits.period_note: 5% cash back on up to $1,500 in combined purchases in that quarter's bonus categories, then 1%. Q4 2026 (Oct 1 to Dec 31, 2026): Grocery Stores (excluding Walmart and Target), Dining, American Red Cross donations; activation opened Sep 15, 2026 and closes Dec 14, 2026. Q1 2027 (Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2027): Grocery Stores (excluding Walmart and Target), Top Streaming Services; activation opens Dec 15, 2026. Q2 2027: categories 'Coming Soon', activation opens Mar 15, 2027. Merchant must submit the charge by the last day of the quarter.
benefits.enrollment_note: Must activate each quarter by the activation deadline at ChaseBonus.com, in the Chase Mobile app, or on chase.com. Activation windows open on the 15th of the month before the quarter begins (Sep 15, Dec 15, Mar 15, Jun 15). Q4 2026 deadline is December 14, 2026 per the Chase press release.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Q4 2026 grocery stores exclude Walmart, Target, wholesale and warehouse clubs, discount stores, drugstores, and gas stations run by grocery merchants. Q4 2026 dining excludes bakeries, caterers, meal kit services, gift card merchants, and stadium, hotel, casino, and theme park concessions unless classified as restaurants. American Red Cross donations must go through official Red Cross channels at redcross.org/chase. Dining stacks with the standing 3% dining rate for 7% total in Q4 2026 until the cap.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com product page and media.chase.com press release on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: New cardmember bonus: $250 cash back
benefits.period_note: Earn $250 bonus (25,000 points) after spending $500 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Allow 6 to 8 weeks to post. Described as a limited-time offer in the Sep 21, 2026 Chase press release with no stated end date; the product page headline shows $200 struck through to $250.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Not available to current cardmembers or anyone who received a new cardmember bonus for this card within the past 24 months.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fee
benefits.period_note: Ongoing. Product page: 'Now enjoy all this with no foreign transaction fee.' Previously a 3% fee applied.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Applies to purchases abroad and from international online merchants.
benefits.verification_note: Fee removal read on creditcards.chase.com and media.chase.com on 2026-10-28. Effective date: Chase cardholder email cited by AwardWallet and The Points Guy says Sep 20, 2026; the Chase press release dated Sep 21, 2026 says 'starting today'.

benefits.name: Cell phone protection (discontinued)
benefits.period_note: Up to $800 per claim, $50 deductible, maximum 2 paid claims and $1,000 per 12-month period, when the monthly wireless bill was paid with the card. Benefit ended September 20, 2026; eligible losses incurred through September 19, 2026 remain covered.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Monthly cell phone bill paid with the Freedom Flex; supplemental to other insurance.
benefits.verification_note: No longer on any issuer page read today; terms and end date from The Points Guy (Jul 14, 2026) and AwardWallet (Jul 17, 2026, updated Oct 13, 2026), both citing Chase's cardholder email.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.period_note: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft up to $500 per item (90 days for New York residents).
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible new purchases made with the card; restrictions and exclusions apply per the Guide to Benefits.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.period_note: Extends the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by one additional year on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible items with U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.period_note: Up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable passenger fares if the trip is canceled or cut short by covered situations such as sickness or severe weather.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Prepaid, non-refundable passenger fares charged to the card; covered situations per the Guide to Benefits.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (secondary)
benefits.period_note: Covers theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles when the rental company's collision insurance is declined and the rental is paid with the card. Secondary to personal insurance in the U.S.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental to the card.

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.period_note: Legal and medical referrals and other travel and emergency assistance; cardmember pays for any goods or services obtained.

benefits.name: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.period_note: Not held responsible for unauthorized charges made with the card or account information.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Does not cover use by an authorized user without the primary cardmember's approval.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass membership (6 months)
benefits.period_note: Six months of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when activated for the first time between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2029. After the free period, membership auto-renews at the then-current monthly rate until canceled. Membership value stated 'as of 10/01/2026'.
benefits.enrollment_note: Activate by December 31, 2029 by adding the Freedom Flex as the default payment method in DoorDash and enrolling in DashPass.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Requires a U.S. address; card must be used at checkout; third-party and digital wallet payments excluded.

benefits.name: DoorDash $10 off one non-restaurant order per quarter
benefits.period_note: Up to $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter through December 31, 2029. Unused discounts do not roll over and have no cash value. Applied as a promotional discount at checkout, not a statement credit.
benefits.enrollment_note: The card used to enroll in DashPass must be used at checkout; requires active DashPass enrollment through the Chase benefit.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Non-restaurant DoorDash orders (grocery, convenience, retail) placed with the enrolled card.

benefits.name: Lyft 2% total cash back
benefits.period_note: 2% total cash back (1% base plus 1% additional) on qualifying Lyft rides and products purchased through the Lyft app, through September 30, 2027.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Rideshare, bike and scooter rides, and Lyft subscription and membership products. Excludes gift cards, car rentals, vehicle service centers, and miscellaneous fees.

benefits.name: Points Boost on select Chase Travel hotels
benefits.period_note: Rotating Points Boost offers on select hotels booked through Chase Travel, worth up to 10% more when redeeming Ultimate Rewards points. Announced September 21, 2026 as new for Freedom cardmembers; available to new and existing cardmembers.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Select hotel redemptions through Chase Travel; offers rotate.
benefits.verification_note: Read on media.chase.com press release on 2026-10-28; not shown on the product page.

benefits.name: 0% intro APR for 15 months
benefits.period_note: 0% intro APR for 15 months from account opening on purchases and balance transfers, then a variable APR. Balance transfer fee applies.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: New accounts only; see Pricing & Terms.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. Post-intro APR text on the page was garbled and is not recorded.

benefits.name: Refer-a-Friend bonus
benefits.period_note: $50 cash back per friend approved for a participating Chase Freedom card, up to $500 per calendar year.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Referred friend must be approved for a participating Chase Freedom card.

earn_rates.cap: $1,500 combined purchases per quarter, then 1%; activation required each quarter
